_about: Play sessions for tower-defense/monitor (td_policy.py). Before each wave, build these towers (x, y on the map), then start the wave and wait for the game to say how it ended. The game is deterministic: `win` is the story's own session and wins all five waves with 2 lives, its enemies crossing 21,7 eight times, all in wave 5; `thin` builds nothing before wave 2 and loses in wave 3, crossing 21,7 a ninth time while lives remain.
